text:
Elena Park: Quick heads-up  I'm opening a small PR to clarify reserved-capacity tagging, add a short terraform migration note, and include an autoscale healthcheck example. Keeping it focused.
Owen Mitchell: Nice. Can you call out the exact terraform field rename? People kept hitting that.
Elena Park: old: `reserved_pool` -> new: `reserved_capacity` and the module now wants `labels` + explicit `reservation` boolean. I'll put a migration snippet.
Priya Nair: Please include a CLI example using redwoodctl and a minimal Python SDK example. Copy/paste is helpful.
Elena Park: Draft CLI + HCL + small SDK example below. Also patching a broken anchor in the quota matrix page.
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...
redwoodctl capacity create --tenant tenant-9 --name reserved-a --labels workload=llm,isolation=reserved --reservation true
```
```hcl
module "capacity" {
  source = "git::.../terraform-capacity?ref=v3"
  tenant_id       = var.tenant_id
  reserved_capacity = var.reserved_count  # was reserved_pool
  labels          = var.labels
  reservation     = var.reservation
}
```
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
client.create_capacity(tenant_id="tenant-9", capacity_name="reserved-a", labels={"isolation":"reserved"}, reservation=True)
```
Danielle Fox: Add a one-line note about preemption: reserved pools reduce preemption risk but shared fallback can happen in rare bursts and may increase tail latency.
Elena Park: Will add that wording and avoid words like "guarantee" per legal.
Priya Nair: I can run staging link checks after merge. Ping me when PR is up.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8305  title: "Docs: reserved-capacity tagging, terraform migration, autoscale healthcheck". Reviewers: @owen, @priya.
Owen Mitchell: Quick nit: mention older SDKs (<v1.8) used `tenant_labels`. Add a migration note to prevent confusion.
Elena Park: Good catch. Adding migration bullet and a tiny rollback CLI (flip reservation=false) for ops.
Danielle Fox: Please tag ops for a 24h observation window after staging deploy.
Elena Park: Will do. Merging after CI. Thanks!
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #8305.
Elena Park: Merged and deployed to staging. Leaving a follow-up comment with the staging URL.
